name: Dhunseri Ventures Limited
summary: Dhunseri Ventures Limited primarily engages in the trading operations of PET resin. The company operates in two segments, Treasury Operations and Trading. It also undertakes treasury operations in shares and securities of other bodies corporate; develops and provides infrastructure facilities in special economic zones for information technology and information technology enabled services; and manufactures and retails confectioneries. In addition, the company manufactures, processes, buys, imports, exports, deals in, and sells various food products for food and beverages industries, as well as its related businesses. Further, it manufactures polyester films. It operates in Italy, India, and internationally. The company was formerly known as Dhunseri Petrochem Limited and changed its name to Dhunseri Ventures Limited in December 2018. The company was incorporated in 1916 and is based in Kolkata, India. Dhunseri Ventures Limited is a subsidiary of Dhunseri Investments Limited.
